grades.lower_bound_mechanism: monovariant Φ = Σ Ω(x_i) + #{x_i > 1}, strictly decreasing (cases gcd = 1 and gcd > 1)
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: invariance of gcd of p-adic valuations via gcd(a, b−a) = gcd(a, b)
grades.notes: Complete rigorous proof. Lemma 1 gives the valuation dynamics (min, max−min); Lemma 2 shows a move never outputs two 1s; Lemma 3's monovariant Φ = T + N strictly decreases in both cases, giving termination, and N ≥ 1 is preserved by induction, so exactly one survivor. Lemma 4 proves gcd-invariance handling equal/zero valuations. Explicit M formula stated and derived.
